title: 3D card and list
description: A picture and a short list. A photo or clip sits in a 3D card that swings in from a steep angle to a gentle one, with a floor reflection, a light that glides across it and a slow drift; the list arrives with big gold serif numbers that count. A person (face given) is never tilted: a tall frame opens with a vertical mask and slowly pushes in, words on the free side.

props.src: required, a photo or an mp4
props.title: required, heading
props.items: up to 4 short lines or {title, text}
props.text: one line instead of a list
props.side: left or right: where the picture goes
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of a face, 0 to 1
props.body: [x, y, w, h] of the person
props.gold: words of the title to colour gold

example.title: Today's bread
example.alt: A croissant on a wooden table
